ui.title: Choose where stock facts come from.
ui.description: Bind profile, market, dividend, and financial capabilities independently; future sources such as Tonghuashun can join the same seam.
ui.loadFailed: Stock data settings could not be loaded right now. Your saved configuration is safe; please try again.
ui.providerHint: Choose a data source, manage its access key, then check the connection. Provider names are managed by the system.
ui.keyConfigured: Key saved; leave blank to keep it
ui.routeHint: Stock profiles, market data, dividends, and financials can use separate sources.
ui.providerSaved: Data source saved. You can verify its connection now.
ui.routesSaved: Data assignments saved. Future reads will use these sources.
ui.verificationNeedsRoute: The connection is saved but has not been verified yet. Check the data assignments and try again.
ui.verified: Connection successful. This stock data source is ready to use.
ui.verificationNeedsConfiguration: There is no usable access key yet. Add and save one, then verify the connection.
ui.verificationUnavailable: We could not connect to the data source. Check the access key and try again later.
ui.error: Stock data settings could not be loaded or saved.

stock_data_provider_validation_failed.title: The stock data provider is invalid
stock_data_provider_validation_failed.detail: Review the provider name and credential action, then try again.

stock_data_provider_definition_unavailab.title: The stock data provider type is unavailable
stock_data_provider_definition_unavailab.detail: Choose an enabled stock data provider type and try again.

stock_data_provider_already_exists.title: This stock data provider is already configured
stock_data_provider_already_exists.detail: Only one instance of each stock data provider type can be configured.

stock_data_provider_not_found.title: The stock data provider was not found
stock_data_provider_not_found.detail: Refresh the settings page and try again.

stock_data_provider_revision_conflict.title: The stock data provider changed
stock_data_provider_revision_conflict.detail: Refresh the settings page and apply your changes again.

stock_data_provider_in_use.title: The stock data provider is still in use
stock_data_provider_in_use.detail: Rebind or clear every stock data route that uses this provider before deleting it.

stock_data_route_validation_failed.title: The stock data routes are invalid
stock_data_route_validation_failed.detail: Submit each stock data capability once and choose only existing providers.

stock_data_route_revision_conflict.title: The stock data routes changed
stock_data_route_revision_conflict.detail: Refresh the settings page and apply the route changes again.
